semantic.justification: Original XStorage/XStorage2 and XHierarchicalStorageAccess/XHierarchicalStorageAccess2 IDL contracts now declare all20 own methods with native Reference, counted Unicode and NamedValue Sequence types. XStorage retains its two required NameAccess/Component bases; version2 interfaces retain their actual single parent and hierarchical access retains implicit XInterface. Optional property/transaction interfaces are not invented as required bases. Normal cppumaker-style static type getters use the genuine CPPU MI factory and type owners; this is not a complete external type-library/member-reflection or physical ABI certificate. Original InvalidStorageException derives from IOException and StorageWrappedTargetException derives from WrappedTargetException, with actual inherited Any value/copy/move/assignment/destruction and correct parent typelib registration. No storage service, partial query provider, fake parent/context/factory or encryption implementation is synthesized. Native OStorage/OWriteStream/package/factory graph, serializer output Reference wiring and complete DOCX/XLSX model/filter/Worker/UI acceptance remain unfinished.
